name: Temporary Sun Ring
summary: A witch-made ring that lets a vampire walk in the sun.
effect: Temporarily lets a vampire walk in sunlight while worn. Unlike the [[sun-ring-pass]], it gives no stat or XP bonus.
steps: Buy a metal ring from the [[general-shop]].
disputed: Prices of 5,000 and 1,000 circulate for buying one; it is also said to be witch-crafted only.
